# BetterDevTools

> A browser DevTools extension (Chrome, Edge and Firefox, Manifest V3) that captures HTTP traffic, inspects large
> responses, replays requests, builds a map of an application's API automatically (API AutoDiscovery: endpoints,
> inferred JSON Schemas, contract validation, dependency graph, OpenAPI export) and exports traffic and collections.
> Everything stays in the browser: no telemetry, no remote services, no permissions at install. TypeScript, Solid, WXT.
> No license has been chosen yet.

## Code map

- [packages/core](packages/core/src): framework-free logic: HAR parsing, filter language, redaction, replay requests, exporters (HAR, JSON, NDJSON, CSV, TOON, Postman, OpenAPI, HTTPie, cURL), and `discovery/` (path normalisation, schema inference, contract validation, dependency graph, OpenAPI/TypeScript/Markdown/HTML export).
- [apps/extension](apps/extension/src): the Solid UI (`components/`), state (`state/`) and the browser adapter (`lib/devtools.ts`).
- [apps/extension/e2e](apps/extension/e2e): Playwright tests, including a real-DevTools capture test.

## Known limits

- Capture needs the panel opened from the browser's DevTools; HAR import works anywhere.
- Browsers do not always give an extension a response body; incomplete captures are labelled and schemas cover only available bodies.
- Inferred schemas describe observed traffic and are not official contracts.
- Releases are zip files for unpacked or temporary loading; there is no store listing yet.
